title: Agent-initiated cross-member messages not captured in conversation logs
context: Roman texted 'Tell Liban to bring the spinach from Target.' Agent relayed to Liban's phone — screenshot confirms delivery. But Liban's conversation log has no record of the outbound relay. Logging is wired for the inbound→response cycle (same phone), not for agent-initiated messages to a different member.
evidence: Screenshot at /Users/libankano/Downloads/Screenshot 2026-02-26 at 2.02.39 AM.png shows 'Roman asked me to let you know: bring the spinach from Target. Thank you' — but grep of Liban's log returns nothing.
recommendation: Don't fix now. Save observation. When we build cross-member messaging as a proper feature, logging needs to cover agent-initiated outbound to any member, not just reply-to-sender.
